summary: First Choice Healthcare Solutions, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 22, 2026, regarding an Amended and Restated Stock Purchase Agreement with Gary C. Bernard, M.D. (Seller). The Company will acquire all outstanding capital stock of Pointe Medical Services, Inc., Pointe Med Pharmacy, Inc., Livewell MD, Inc., and all membership interests of Live Well Drugstore, LLC (d/b/a Trulife Pharmacy), after Seller first acquires minority interests. A $200,000 Purchase Price Advance was paid upon execution. The filing references a related Business Combination Agreement with Westin Acquisition Corp. and First Choice Acquisition Corp., suggesting a broader transaction. Terms, price per share, and premium were not disclosed. What to watch: closing conditions and integration with the Westin business combination.
